races.title: Remembering Hendrix 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FORTIS ET LIBER went close on penultimate outing for Colin Bowe and having joined the all-conquering Dan Skelton yard, he's fancied to open his account at the expense of Theybouncewell , who ran a cracker on her first start of any description at Hereford last month and is entitled to progress. Arms Park , who won his bumper over C&D, looks the only other one capable of getting involved. FORTIS ET LIBER THEYBOUNCEWELL (IRE) ARMS PARK
races.bettingForecast: Fortis Et Liber (1/1), Arms Park (15/8), Theybouncewell (10/3), Timmie Two (28/1), Maucourt D'airy (125/1), She's A Driver (250/1)

races.title: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NOWHERENEARMILAN steps up to 3m for first time and could be worth a chance in a thin race. Makinbecon and Dublinofficecallin appeal most of those with handicap form. NOWHERENEARMILAN (IRE) MAKINBECON DUBLINOFFICECALLIN

races.title: Stag Environmental Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: COURAGEOUS STRIKE looks the class angle in here, and he's taken to resume winning ways following a breathing operation. Course specialist Taritino is feared most, ahead of Into Battle and Holeshot . COURAGEOUS STRIKE TARITINO (IRE) INTO BATTLE (IRE)

races.title: Stables Business Park Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Interesting stable-switcher ASIAN SPICE gets the call over last-time-out winner Savanna Storm . Raffles Nobu and Gone Country are others to consider in an open-looking race. ASIAN SPICE SAVANNA STORM (IRE) RAFFLES NOBU (FR)

races.title: Mike Trickey & Geoff White Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A tricky betting race. Neither Calvino nor Tashan look rock solid so a chance is taken on KANDOR who hasn't been long with a very capable yard. KANDOR (FR) CALVINO (IRE) TASHAN
races.bettingForecast: Calvino (11/10), Tashan (11/4), Lord Cauvelliere (3/1), Kandor (7/1), D'jo Dela Barriere (7/1)

races.title: Christmas Sparkle Charity Raceday 10 December Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FRENCH FANCY offered something to work on when third in a slowly-run bumper at Worcester on his debut last month and could well be up to making it second time lucky. Kilifi Creek failed to meet expectations over C&D on his debut back in April but could prove a different proposition in a first-time hood. Handsome Stan also merits consideration. FRENCH FANCY (FR) KILIFI CREEK (IRE) HANDSOME STAN
races.bettingForecast: Kilifi Creek (5/2), French Fancy (3/1), Handsome Stan (10/3), Hawkpitt (4/1), Powerful Act (6/1), Snowy Hill (28/1), Jack Dandy (50/1)
